items.title: Assignment-bound Source Catalog und Reviewbasis herstellen
items.decision: Hub-owned catalog, allowlist and automatic run evidence are reproducibly bound by this pack.

items.title: Artifact-, Upload-, Extraction- und Spreadsheet-Bestand inventarisieren
items.decision: Artifact import and immutable candidates exist; durable production persistence remains Phase 2.

items.title: ml_intern-, Unsloth-, Dataset-, Evaluation- und Inferenz-Fit prüfen
items.decision: Spreadsheet task-family contracts, consent lineage and dataset projection exist; full training admission remains Phase 2.

items.title: Hub-Task-, WorkerJob-, Lease-, Fencing- und Result-Ingress-Fit prüfen
items.decision: The current synchronous HTTP adapter is experimental and must be replaced by the Hub task queue before production admission.

items.title: Angular-, Navigation-, Shared-UI- und Modelltraining-Fit prüfen
items.decision: The Angular feature and Hub API facade exist; virtualization and accessibility hardening remain.

items.title: Threat Model und Trust Boundaries für Dokumente, Worker, Modelle und Nutzer festlegen
items.decision: The threat model fixes Browser, Hub, stores and isolated Worker trust boundaries with fail-closed gates.

items.title: Dokument-, Archiv-, Formel- und Export-Policy fail-closed entscheiden
items.decision: Closed actions and no-macro execution exist; archive, formula and export policy need broader negative coverage.

items.title: LibreOffice-Sandbox-, Netzwerk- und Runtime-Profil verifizieren
items.decision: Non-root, read-only and no-network workload controls exist; seccomp/AppArmor and authenticated callback hardening remain.

items.title: RBAC, Tenantgrenzen, Audit, Handles, Quoten und Retention entscheiden
items.decision: Tenant/project checks and opaque IDs exist; durable quotas, retention and download handles remain.

items.title: Datenschutz, Lizenz, Consent und Adapter-Widerrufsfolgen entscheiden
items.decision: Consent digest binding, revocation fencing, quarantine and retraining lineage are implemented without false unlearning claims.

items.title: Immutable Artifact- und Dokumentversions-State-Machine definieren
items.decision: Immutable in-process original/candidate/published artifacts exist; database repository and migration remain.

items.title: Kanonisches Workbook- und Snapshot-Modell festlegen
items.decision: Canonical snapshots cover stable sheets, cells, formulas and styles; richer Calc objects remain capability-gated.

items.title: Geschlossene Action-, Formula- und Actual-Diff-Verträge definieren
items.decision: The V1 discriminated action union, range operations, formula policy and actual diff are implemented.

items.title: Deterministische Validator- und Ergebnisverträge definieren
items.decision: Deterministic validator results exist; formula AST, reference artifacts and deeper invariants remain.

items.title: Hub-owned Proposal-, Dry-run-, Validation- und Promotion-Saga definieren
items.decision: The Hub owns the proposal/dry-run/validate/apply saga, but queue-backed Worker execution is still required.

items.title: Optimistic Concurrency, Idempotenz und Konfliktsemantik entscheiden
items.decision: Digest-bound Worker results, immutable exports and bounded payloads exist; standard lease/callback integration remains.

items.title: Feedback-Event und versioniertes Consent-Ledger definieren
items.decision: Feedback, validation, apply approval and training consent are distinct immutable decisions.

items.title: Trainingsrecord-Projektion, Maskierung und Privacy-Preview entscheiden
items.decision: Masked privacy preview and digest-bound training records are implemented.

items.title: Lineage-, Deduplizierungs- und leakagesichere Split-Policy definieren
items.decision: Lineage and deterministic split metadata exist; near-duplicate clustering needs production-scale implementation.

items.title: Dataset-Recipe-, Materialisierungs- und Promotionsvertrag definieren
items.decision: Immutable recipes and dataset versions exist; durable promotion and large-scale materialization remain.

items.title: Additive Spreadsheet-Task-Family- und Kompatibilitätsstrategie entscheiden
items.decision: A closed additive spreadsheet task family preserves legacy defaults and strategy boundaries.

items.title: Base-Modell-Baseline und Dataset-Readiness-Go/No-Go definieren
items.decision: Quantitative base-model baseline and dataset-readiness admission must be implemented before real training.

items.title: Worker-seitiges Spreadsheet-LoRA/QLoRA-Training und Artefaktprofil definieren
items.decision: Worker contracts and Unsloth-compatible records exist; real profile-driven LoRA/QLoRA execution remains.

items.title: Ausführungsgestützte Spreadsheet-Evaluation und Admission-Gates definieren
items.decision: Execution-backed validation primitives exist; complete base-versus-adapter evaluation admission remains.

items.title: Adapter-Approval, Revocation und strikt strukturierte Inferenz entscheiden
items.decision: Structured task-family output and revocation lineage exist; registry admission and runtime unload remain.

items.title: Hub-API-, DTO-, Route- und Authorization-Verträge schneiden
items.decision: Spreadsheet APIs, DTOs, routing and tenant-bound Angular facade are implemented additively.

items.title: Virtualisierten Workbook-Viewer und Rendering-Semantik entscheiden
items.decision: Workbook preview and version selection exist; tile virtualization and richer rendering remain.

items.title: Proposal-, Diff-, Validator-, Feedback- und Consent-UX trennen
items.decision: Proposal, diff, validation, apply, feedback, consent and revocation are distinct UI states.

items.title: Dataset-, Split-, Training-, Evaluation- und Adapter-UX integrieren
items.decision: Dataset and training views exist; production evaluation, split-lock and adapter lifecycle UX remain.

items.title: Quantitative Limits, Fixtures und Testmatrix festlegen
items.decision: The test matrix defines numerical budgets, automatic gates and explicit not_run semantics.

items.title: Observability, Recovery, SLOs und Betriebsgrenzen definieren
items.decision: Operational identifiers are available, but SLO dashboards and recovery runbooks remain Phase 2.

items.title: Phase-2-Tracks in kleine SOLID-konforme Slices und einen geschlossenen DAG schneiden
items.decision: The generated Phase-2 track is a closed, SRP-oriented DAG bound to these source item IDs.

items.title: Research-Coverage, Grounding und Promotion Readiness abschließen
items.decision: Schema, DAG, meta, catalog, claims and automatic promotion are validated by the Hub contract gate.
